opener_concept: A phone charger is a transformer: volts per turn is the same on both coils, so 10 turns at 20 V is 2 V/turn and a 5-turn output gives 10 V. Naming this IS the turns-ratio equation Vs = Vp x (Ns/Np).
board_neutral: No board named; equations framed as 'check whether your board gives you this equation'. Whole unit is HT/Separate by design.
notes: Tier ladder matches the science spec: Bronze one equation straight in; Silver rearrange or power-balance; Gold chains power-balance then P=I2R (grid transmission). No unit-conversion boxes needed: all quantities (V, A, turns, ohm, W) are already base units. Propagates to 1 row (canonical only); readback byte-identical, guided+tier_guides confirmed live.
